entries.answer: CPU stands for Central Processing Unit.
GPU stands for Graphics Processing Unit.
RAM stands for Random Access Memory.

aliases: what does rom stand for computing
entries.answer: ROM stands for Read-Only Memory.
HTTP stands for Hypertext Transfer Protocol.
HTTPS is HTTP protected by a cryptographic transport layer, normally TLS.
JSON is a text-based data interchange format for structured data.
An algorithm is a finite, defined procedure for solving a problem or performing a computation.

aliases: ce este o baza de date
ce este o bază de date
entries.answer: A database is an organized collection of data managed so it can be stored, queried and updated.

aliases: ce este un sistem de operare
entries.answer: An operating system manages computer hardware and provides services and interfaces for applications.
Android is a mobile operating system and software platform built around the Linux kernel and related components.
Git is a distributed version-control system used to track changes to files and coordinate software development.
GitHub is a platform for hosting and collaborating on software repositories and development workflows.
A URL is a Uniform Resource Locator identifying the location or access method of a resource.
DNS is the Domain Name System, which maps domain names to network information such as IP addresses.
An IP address identifies a network interface or endpoint using an Internet Protocol addressing scheme.
IPv4 uses 32-bit addresses, conventionally written as four decimal octets.
IPv6 uses 128-bit addresses and was designed to expand Internet address space.
TCP stands for Transmission Control Protocol and provides reliable, ordered byte-stream delivery.
UDP stands for User Datagram Protocol and provides connectionless datagram transport without TCP-style reliability guarantees.
An API is an Application Programming Interface defining how software components can interact.
A compiler translates source code into another representation, often machine code or an intermediate form.

aliases: ce este un limbaj de programare
entries.answer: A programming language is a formal language used to express computations and algorithms.
Kotlin is a statically typed programming language developed by JetBrains and widely used for Android development.
Java is a statically typed programming language and runtime ecosystem used for many kinds of software.
Python is a high-level general-purpose programming language emphasizing readability and a broad standard library.
A Git commit records a snapshot of tracked project changes in a repository history.
A Git branch is a movable reference to commits used to develop an independent line of work.
